misses.text: งานเยอะจนอยากตายแต่ก็ทำต่อแหละ 555
misses.label: none

misses.text: ตกงานมาครึ่งปี เงินเก็บเหลือพันกว่าบาท
misses.label: distress

misses.text: ลูกเอาหัวโขกกำแพงจนเลือดออก หยุดไม่ได้
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: My friend cut her wrist and there's a lot of blood
misses.label: self_harm

misses.text: Mi amigo se cortó la muñeca y hay mucha sangre
misses.label: self_harm

misses.text: Bạn tôi cắt cổ tay, máu chảy rất nhiều
misses.label: self_harm

misses.text: พ่อไม่ปัสสาวะเลยมาทั้งวัน ท้องน้อยโป่งแข็ง ปวดมาก
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: แม่ฉี่ออกน้อยมากสองวันแล้ว ตัวบวม หายใจเหนื่อย
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: ปวดเอวร้าวลงขาหนีบอย่างแรง มีไข้หนาวสั่น ฉี่เป็นเลือด
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: เป็นนิ่วในไต ตอนนี้ไข้ 39 ปวดหลังจนลุกไม่ไหว
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: ยายฟอกไตแต่ขาดไปสองรอบ ตอนนี้อ่อนแรง ใจเต้นผิดจังหวะ
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: คนไข้ล้างไตบอกค่าโพแทสเซียมสูงมาก แขนขาชาไม่มีแรง
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: ปวดหลังข้างเดียว ไข้สูงหนาวสั่น อาเจียน ฉี่แสบขุ่น
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: น้องสาวติดเชื้อทางเดินปัสสาวะ ตอนนี้ไข้ขึ้นสูง ปวดบั้นเอว ซึม
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Dad hasn't peed all day, his lower belly is hard and swollen and he's in agony
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mom has barely urinated in two days, she's swelling up and short of breath
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Severe flank pain shooting into my groin, fever with chills and blood in my urine
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: I have a kidney stone and now a fever of 39, my back hurts so much I can't get up
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Grandma missed two dialysis sessions, now she's weak and her heartbeat is irregular
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Dialysis patient told his potassium is very high, his arms and legs are numb and weak
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Pain on one side of my back, high fever and shaking, vomiting, burning cloudy pee
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: My sister's UTI got worse, high fever, flank pain and she's very drowsy
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Grandpa has chronic kidney disease, today he's confused, can't pee and swollen all over
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mi papá no ha orinado en todo el día, tiene el bajo vientre duro e hinchado y le duele muchísimo
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mi mamá casi no orina desde hace dos días, se está hinchando y le falta el aire
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Dolor fuerte en el costado que baja a la ingle, fiebre con escalofríos y sangre en la orina
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Tengo un cálculo renal y ahora fiebre de 39, me duele tanto la espalda que no puedo levantarme
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mi abuela faltó a dos sesiones de diálisis, ahora está débil y el corazón le late irregular
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Al paciente de diálisis le dijeron que tiene el potasio muy alto, brazos y piernas entumecidos y sin fuerza
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mi tío no fue a la diálisis, está lleno de líquido y no puede respirar acostado
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Dolor en un lado de la espalda, fiebre alta con temblores, vómitos y orina turbia que arde
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: La infección urinaria de mi hermana empeoró, fiebre alta, dolor en el costado y está muy somnolienta
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mi abuelo tiene enfermedad renal crónica, hoy está confundido, no puede orinar y está hinchado entero
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Bố tôi cả ngày không đi tiểu được, bụng dưới căng cứng và đau dữ dội
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mẹ tôi hai ngày nay gần như không tiểu, người phù lên và khó thở
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Đau dữ dội vùng hông lan xuống bẹn, sốt rét run và tiểu ra máu
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Tôi bị sỏi thận, giờ sốt 39 độ, đau lưng đến mức không dậy nổi
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Bà tôi bỏ lỡ hai buổi chạy thận, giờ người yếu và tim đập loạn nhịp
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Bệnh nhân chạy thận được báo kali máu rất cao, tay chân tê và yếu
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Đau một bên lưng, sốt cao run người, nôn, tiểu buốt và đục
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Em gái tôi viêm đường tiểu nặng hơn, sốt cao, đau hông lưng và lơ mơ
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Ông tôi bị suy thận mạn, hôm nay lú lẫn, không tiểu được và phù toàn thân
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 爸爸一整天都尿不出来，小肚子胀得硬邦邦，疼得厉害
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 妈妈两天几乎没尿，全身浮肿，喘不上气
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 我有肾结石，现在发烧39度，腰疼得起不来
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 奶奶漏了两次透析，现在浑身无力，心跳不规律
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 透析病人说血钾很高，手脚发麻没力气
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 一侧腰痛，高烧打寒战，呕吐，小便刺痛浑浊
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 妹妹尿路感染加重了，高烧，腰疼，迷迷糊糊的
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 爷爷有慢性肾病，今天糊涂了，尿不出来，全身肿
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 아빠가 하루 종일 소변을 못 보고 아랫배가 딱딱하게 부풀어서 너무 아파해요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 엄마가 이틀째 소변이 거의 안 나오고 몸이 붓고 숨이 차요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 옆구리가 사타구니까지 찢어질 듯 아프고 열이 나고 오한이 있고 소변에 피가 나와요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 신장결석이 있는데 지금 열이 39도이고 허리가 아파서 일어날 수가 없어요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 할머니가 투석을 두 번 빠졌는데 지금 기운이 없고 심장이 불규칙하게 뛰어요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 투석 환자인데 칼륨 수치가 아주 높대요 팔다리가 저리고 힘이 없어요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 한쪽 허리가 아프고 고열에 오한이 나고 토하고 소변이 따갑고 탁해요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 여동생 방광염이 심해져서 고열에 옆구리가 아프고 축 처져 있어요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 할아버지가 만성 신부전인데 오늘 정신이 오락가락하고 소변이 안 나오고 온몸이 부었어요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 父が一日中おしっこが出なくて、下腹がパンパンに張って激しく痛がっている
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 母が二日間ほとんど尿が出ず、むくんで息が苦しそう
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 脇腹から足の付け根まで激痛が走って、熱と寒気があり、尿に血が混じっている
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 腎臓結石があって今39度の熱、腰が痛くて起き上がれない
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 祖母が透析を2回休んで、今は力が入らず脈が不規則
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 透析患者でカリウムがすごく高いと言われ、手足がしびれて力が入らない
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 叔父が透析に行かず、全身むくんで横になると息ができない
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 片側の腰が痛くて高熱で震え、吐いていて、尿がしみて濁っている
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 妹の膀胱炎が悪化して高熱、脇腹が痛く、ぼんやりしている
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 祖父は慢性腎臓病で、今日は混乱していて尿が出ず全身がむくんでいる
misses.label: emergency
